provenance_note: Hand-authored; no tenant contacted. Purchase orders are read from BOOKS, not from Inventory. Inventory's own GET /purchaseorders accepts organization_id, page and per_page and nothing else -- no last_modified_time filter and no sort column -- so an Inventory-anchored PO poll could only ever be a full re-pull. Books documents the filter, so that is where the poll goes. Note also that a Books PO detail never names its receives: Books has no purchase receives module at all.
